title: E321's named share was measured with a needle that refuses four faces; re-run the five-class census over the whole population with E322's wider needle
verdict_reason: 196 rows re-classified under the wider needle (2341 corpus files): 25 rows move class, 25 of them to a LESS named class, and the named count goes 21 -> 21. The named share was 10.7 pct with the literal needle and is 10.7 pct now. A naively accumulated producer set would report 28 named rows, but all 7 of the extra names come from family needles (a composed prefix or a sibling filename) rather than from the face's own path, so attribution refuses them and the published figure is the attended one.
